title: One Federation common definitions
description: Shared value types of the One Federation A2A extension (extension URI https://suiss.app/a2a/one-federation/v1).

extensionUri.description: The One Federation extension URI. It is the key of the extension object in A2A metadata maps and the value listed in A2A `extensions` arrays.

schemaVersion.description: Extension schema version MAJOR.MINOR. MAJOR equals the URI major (v1). A MINOR increase only adds optional members; peers use the highest version both declare in their Agent Card.

did.description: A did:web identifier (lower-case host, optional percent-encoded port, optional path segments).

party.description: A person and the agent acting for that person. The agent never stands in for the person.

agent.description: The identifier of the agent instance acting for the person.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with a `Z` suffix.

messageId.description: A2A `messageId`; the receiver deduplicates on it.

correlationId.description: Work correlation identifier. Created with the first offer, identical for the whole offer chain and equal to the A2A `contextId`.

offerVersion.description: Offer version of the chain. 1 for the first offer; each counter-offer is exactly one greater than the highest version in the chain; 0 only for a query or answer before any offer.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the referenced A2A Message with the extension object's `handle` member removed; `sha-256:` followed by unpadded base64url.

authorityRef.description: Reference to the authority proof the recipient verifies at the identity and authority service: that the agent acts for the person for this kind of message. The reference is not itself authority.

ref.description: Opaque, resolvable reference issued by the identity and authority service.

digest.description: Digest of the referenced proof, so a substituted proof is detected.

capabilityRef.description: A capability of the semantic capability taxonomy, by name and version, as defined by the capability name schema. Typed fields are validated against that capability's input or output JSON Schema from the capability registry; this extension defines no field dictionary of its own.

typedFields.description: Typed field values. Valid only if they validate against the referenced capability schema; anything else is refused, never coerced.

messageRef.description: Reference to an earlier message of the same chain.

declineReason.description: Reason code of a rejection; mirrors the reason set of the Work decline operation.

refusal.description: Protocol-level refusal codes a receiver returns for a message it does not accept.
